europe_now.title: Channel Tunnel Entryway Collision Injures 19
europe_now.summary: Nineteen people suffered injuries when a minibus collided with a stationary train on the French side of the Channel Tunnel entrance. Emergency services responded to the incident, which caused significant disruptions in the transport hub.

europe_now.title: Black Sea Drone Incident Leaves Several Missing
europe_now.summary: At least seven individuals are reported missing off the coast of Romania following a series of recent drone attacks in the Black Sea region. Security officials continue to monitor the maritime area amid escalating military tensions.

top_stories.title: Franco-German Agreement on Car Emissions Regulations
top_stories.summary: France and Germany successfully reached a new compromise to ease strict European Union car emissions rules following initial delays and discord. This agreement addresses major industrial concerns within the bloc while shaping future environmental policy.

top_stories.summary: European leaders face mounting pressure to reach a formal agreement on the bloc's budget by December or November. Divergent views among member states have sparked intense debates during recent high-level meetings.
